# External References: report-feature

**Phase:** External Research
**Date:** 2026-05-08

---

## Loading UX

- [Smart Interface Design Patterns — Designing Better Loading and Progress UX](https://smart-interface-design-patterns.com/articles/designing-better-loading-progress-ux/) — Comprehensive breakdown of wait-time psychology and the right progress patterns by duration bucket (1s / 3s / 10s+)

- [Smashing Magazine — Best Practices For Animated Progress Indicators](https://www.smashingmagazine.com/2016/12/best-practices-for-animated-progress-indicators/) — The research foundation on determinate vs. indeterminate indicators and perceived speed

- [UXPin — Progress Tracker Design Best Practices 2026](https://www.uxpin.com/studio/blog/design-progress-trackers/) — Current recommendations for multi-step progress experiences

- [Lollypop Design — Boost SaaS UX with Smarter Progress Indicators](https://lollypop.design/blog/2025/november/progress-indicator-design/) — SaaS-specific progress bar guidance from 2025

- [Golden Eagle — The Art of Loading Screens in UX](https://goldeneagle.ai/blog/software-development/ux-loading-screens-user-experience/) — How to make waiting feel like part of the product experience

---

## Conversion: Paywall + Free-to-Paid

- [RevenueCat — 5 Overlooked Paywall Improvements](https://www.revenuecat.com/blog/growth/paywall-conversion-boosters/) — Data-backed list of paywall improvements, including timing, social proof placement, and trial mechanics

- [RevenueCat — Four Paywall Redesign Case Studies](https://www.revenuecat.com/blog/growth/paywall-redesigns-case-studies/) — Real before/after conversion data from paywall redesigns (including the 17% ARPU lift case)

- [The Momentum — Optimize Paywall Conversion Rates with UX](https://www.themomentum.ai/blog/how-to-successfully-optimize-paywall-conversion-rates-with-ux) — Framework for timing, social proof, urgency, and trial mechanics in paywalls

- [Userpilot — Free-to-Paid Conversion Strategy](https://userpilot.com/blog/free-to-paid-conversion-strategy/) — Includes activation milestone trigger concept — "prompt upgrade after first value moment"

- [Crazy Egg — Free-to-Paid Conversion Rates Explained](https://www.crazyegg.com/blog/free-to-paid-conversion-rate/) — Benchmarks: 48.8% for opt-out trials vs. 18.2% for opt-in

- [Contextsdk — Optimizing Paywalls with Context](https://contextsdk.com/blogposts/optimizing-paywalls-best-practices-and-real-world-context-for-higher-conversions) — Context-aware paywall timing guidance

---

## Progressive Disclosure + AI Document Reveal

- [AI UX Design Guide — Progressive Disclosure in AI](https://www.aiuxdesign.guide/patterns/progressive-disclosure) — How to layer AI output for both agents and user-facing documents

- [UXPin — What is Progressive Disclosure (2026)](https://www.uxpin.com/studio/blog/what-is-progressive-disclosure/) — Current definition and use cases for progressive disclosure in modern interfaces

- [Nielsen Norman Group — Progressive Disclosure](https://www.nngroup.com/articles/progressive-disclosure/) — The foundational research article on why staged reveals reduce cognitive load

---

## LLM Text Animation Libraries

- [FlowToken GitHub](https://github.com/Ephibbs/flowtoken) — React library for animating LLM streaming output. `AnimatedMarkdown` component with per-word/per-char animations

- [FlowToken npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/flowtoken) — Package page with version history and install instructions

- [FlowToken in Vercel AI SDK discussion](https://github.com/vercel/ai/discussions/2391) — Community usage with Next.js and useChat hook

- [Motion.dev — Typewriter Component](https://motion.dev/docs/react-typewriter) — 1.3kb React typewriter component with natural typing behavior

- [LogRocket — 5 Ways to Implement Typing Animation in React](https://blog.logrocket.com/5-ways-implement-typing-animation-react/) — Overview of approaches and tradeoffs

---

## Audit/Report Visual Design

- [Venngage — Free Audit Report Templates](https://venngage.com/templates/reports/audit) — Visual reference for professional audit report design patterns

- [Semrush — My Reports (documentation)](https://www.semrush.com/kb/34-my-reports) — How a leading SaaS audit tool structures its reports (data viz options: Simple Number, Table, Donut, Line, Bar)

- [Eleken — Design Audit Example](https://www.eleken.co/blog-posts/design-audit-example-insights-to-improve-conversion-rates) — Process and output structure for professional design audits

## PDF Export

- [Nutrient — HTML to PDF in React with jsPDF](https://www.nutrient.io/blog/how-to-convert-html-to-pdf-using-react/) — Practical guide with CSS variable handling notes

- [react-to-pdf npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-to-pdf) — Simplest PDF export option for React components

- [@react-pdf/renderer](https://react-pdf.org/) — Higher quality PDF output with text as text objects (not images)

## UX Delight Micro-Interactions

- [Magic UI — Confetti Component](https://magicui.design/docs/components/confetti) — Customizable confetti for React with brand color support

- [react-confetti npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-confetti) — Lightest confetti option for completion moments

- [DEV Community — Micro-Interactions vs Animations for SaaS Conversions](https://dev.to/hashbyt/micro-interactions-vs-animations-which-converts-better-and-why-it-matters-in-saas-ux-5d1l) — Data on which micro-animations actually improve conversion
